title: swesphere: shallow-water equations on the rotating sphere with documented, reproducible flow regimes
description: A compact Python implementation of the shallow-water equations on the sphere, verified against the standard test cases, with three characterized flow regimes, a state-vector interface, a pluggable time integrator and a containerized set of experiments that regenerates every reported number.

creators.name: Nino-Ruiz, Elias D.
creators.affiliation: Applied Math and Computer Science Lab, Universidad del Norte, Barranquilla, Colombia
